facts.activity_file: proving overpressure protection is in service

assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unrelieved potential energy found after isolation of PSV-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-4110 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. PSV-4110 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 15 May 2026 a high potential incident was recorded on PSV-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a statutory inspection; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
